Every payload here is hand-written from the Antigravity hooks reference (https://antigravity.google/docs/hooks), read on
15 Nov 2026. None is recorded yet: release-03-T1 records real sessions into
`payloads/<agent-version>/*-recorded*.json`. `*.event.json` are the expected
normalized events; regenerate with `go test ./internal/adapter/antigravity -update`.
